$comment: HWDT Phase 1 backlog-as-code. Applied by scripts/provision/provision_jira_backlog.py (idempotent via label hwdt-ref-<ref>). Keys are deterministic on a fresh project: EPIC-001..008 = HWDT-1..8 (provision_jira.py), then the items below in order = HWDT-9..20.
phase: Phase 1: Employee Digital Twin + Credential Management Core

items.description: As an HR manager I can create, view, update and archive employee digital profiles so the workforce twin reflects the real hospital staff.
acceptanceCriteria: GET/POST /employees, GET/PUT/DELETE /employees/{id} implemented with JWT auth
employee_number, email and national_id unique among active employees (409 on conflict)
Input validated server-side with field-level 422 errors
DELETE is a soft delete (deleted_at, status TERMINATED) with audit log entry
Search + filter by department, role and category, paginated

items.description: As HR staff I can browse employees and open a profile page showing personal information, department, role, skills and credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Employee list with search and filters (department, role, category, status)
Profile page: personal info, department, role, skills, credentials, compliance status
Create/edit forms with inline validation messages from the API
National ID masked for non-HR roles

items.description: As an administrator I can maintain the list of hospital departments (ICU, Emergency, Surgery, Pediatrics, Administration…).
acceptanceCriteria: departments table seeded with reference data
GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /departments
Department in use cannot be deleted (409)
UI to add and remove departments

items.description: As HR I can maintain a skills catalogue (ACLS, BLS, Dialysis, NICU Care…) and record each employee's skill level and years of experience. This is the foundation for the Phase 2 matching engine.
acceptanceCriteria: skills + employee_skills tables (level, years_experience)
GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /skills
POST/DELETE /employees/{id}/skills
Skills visible and editable on the profile page

items.description: As a compliance officer I can record professional credentials (licences, registrations, certifications, training) for each employee.
acceptanceCriteria: GET/POST /employees/{id}/credentials, PUT/DELETE /credentials/{id}
Rule 3: professional licences/registrations only for clinical employees (422 otherwise)
Issue date not in the future; expiry >= issue date
Material changes reset verification

items.description: As a compliance officer I can verify a credential against the source document; the verifier and timestamp are recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /credentials/{id}/verify restricted to ADMIN / COMPLIANCE_OFFICER
verified_by + verified_at stored and shown in UI
Expired credentials cannot be verified (Rule 2)
Audit log entry CREDENTIAL_VERIFIED

items.description: The system computes the credential status from today's date: VALID (> 60 days), EXPIRING_SOON (<= 60 days), EXPIRED (past expiry), PENDING_VERIFICATION (unverified).
acceptanceCriteria: Rule 1 implemented identically in TypeScript (credential.rules.ts) and SQL (credential.compute_status)
Rule 2: EXPIRED overrides verification; isValid=false exposed in the API
GET /credentials/expiring returns 30- and 60-day buckets; GET /credentials/expired
Automated boundary tests (-3..+65 days) prove SQL == TypeScript

items.description: As an HR manager I see total employees, clinical employees, active, expiring and expired credentials, plus non-compliant staff and upcoming expiries.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /dashboard/summary
KPI cards: Total Employees, Clinical Employees, Active/Expiring/Expired Credentials
Status distribution, per-department risk, upcoming expiries, non-compliant employees
Credential management page with Expiring ≤30 / ≤60 / Expired / Pending tabs

items.description: Add backend and frontend services to docker-compose, hwdt_db database/role, nginx vhost hwdt.local and backups for hwdt_db.
acceptanceCriteria: docker compose up -d starts frontend + backend with health checks
Backend migrates on start
hwdt.local routed by nginx (/api/v1 → backend)
hwdt_db included in backups

items.description: Backend unit + integration tests (real PostgreSQL) and frontend component tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Employee creation/update tests
Credential creation, expiry calculation and expired detection tests
Employee list, profile page and credential status display tests
All tests green

items.description: Phase 1 Architecture, Database Documentation, API Documentation and Business Rules pages.
acceptanceCriteria: 4 pages in docs/ published to the HWDT Confluence space by the provisioner

items.description: Users sign in with email/password (scrypt hashes) and receive an expiring JWT; permissions are prepared for ADMIN, HR_MANAGER, COMPLIANCE_OFFICER and EMPLOYEE.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /auth/login, GET /auth/me
JWT HS256 with exp/iss/aud; expired tokens rejected (401 TOKEN_EXPIRED)
Permission matrix enforced on every route
Login rate limiting; generic error messages
